Ptilopsis:MedicalInstruction.NAME: Medic: Instruction
Ptilopsis:MedicalInstruction.DESCRIPTION: Apply !M! Vulnerable. NL Deal !D! damage. NL ptilopsis:Construct a fixed ptilopsis:Thread. NL ptilopsis:Function: Deal 3 damage to ALL enemies. NL ptilopsis:Destruct: Deal 6 damage to ALL enemies.
Ptilopsis:MedicalInstruction.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Apply !M! Vulnerable. NL Deal !D! damage. NL ptilopsis:Construct a fixed ptilopsis:Thread. NL ptilopsis:Function: Deal 4 damage to ALL enemies. NL ptilopsis:Destruct: Deal 8 damage to ALL enemies.

Ptilopsis:BootThread.NAME: Boot Thread
Ptilopsis:BootThread.DESCRIPTION: ptilopsis:Construct 1 empty Mutable ptilopsis:Thread. NL Gain !B! Block. NL Draw !M! card. NL Exhaust.

Ptilopsis:ReadOnlyThread.NAME: Read-Only Thread
Ptilopsis:ReadOnlyThread.DESCRIPTION: Retain. NL ptilopsis:Construct 1 Fixed ptilopsis:Thread. NL ptilopsis:Construct and ptilopsis:Function: gain !B! Block. NL ptilopsis:Destruct: draw !M! card. NL Exhaust.

Ptilopsis:WakeRoutine.NAME: Wake Routine
Ptilopsis:WakeRoutine.DESCRIPTION: Draw !M! cards. NL ptilopsis:Construct 1 Fixed ptilopsis:Thread: at the start of your turn, draw !M! cards. NL ptilopsis:Trigger or ptilopsis:Destruct: gain [E] and draw 1 card.
Ptilopsis:WakeRoutine.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Innate. NL Draw !M! cards. NL ptilopsis:Construct 1 Fixed ptilopsis:Thread: at the start of your turn, draw !M! cards. NL ptilopsis:Trigger or ptilopsis:Destruct: gain [E] and draw 1 card.

Ptilopsis:CacheRefresh.NAME: Cache Refresh
Ptilopsis:CacheRefresh.DESCRIPTION: Draw !M! card. NL Draw 1 more for each ptilopsis:Thread with a ptilopsis:Function. NL Exhaust.

Ptilopsis:Enkephalin.NAME: Enkephalin
Ptilopsis:Enkephalin.DESCRIPTION: Each turn, when you first play a card manually, ptilopsis:Mount its ptilopsis:Function for free and draw 1 card.
Ptilopsis:Enkephalin.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Gain 1 ptilopsis:Thread slot. NL Each turn, when you first play a card manually, ptilopsis:Mount its ptilopsis:Function for free and draw 1 card.

Ptilopsis:DivideAndConquer.NAME: Divide and Conquer
Ptilopsis:DivideAndConquer.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Apply !M! ptilopsis:Master_Theorem to ALL enemies. NL Exhaust.

Ptilopsis:CoroutineYield.NAME: Coroutine Yield
Ptilopsis:CoroutineYield.DESCRIPTION: ptilopsis:Trigger all ptilopsis:Threads once. NL Exhaust.

Ptilopsis:CrystallineDream.NAME: Crystalline Dream
Ptilopsis:CrystallineDream.DESCRIPTION: ptilopsis:Destruct all your ptilopsis:Threads. NL Gain !B! Block for each ptilopsis:Thread destructed. NL Exhaust.
Ptilopsis:CrystallineDream.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: ptilopsis:Destruct all your ptilopsis:Threads. NL Gain !B! Block for each ptilopsis:Thread destructed.

Ptilopsis:Hyperthreading.NAME: Hyperthreading
Ptilopsis:Hyperthreading.DESCRIPTION: At the end of your turn, ptilopsis:Trigger your leftmost ptilopsis:Thread 1 additional time.
Ptilopsis:Hyperthreading.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: At the end of your turn, ptilopsis:Trigger your leftmost and rightmost ptilopsis:Threads 1 additional time each. NL If you have only 1 ptilopsis:Thread, ptilopsis:Trigger it twice.

Ptilopsis:MergeSort.NAME: Merge Sort
Ptilopsis:MergeSort.DESCRIPTION: Sort your draw pile by cost, drawing the cheapest cards first. NL Gain !B! Block for each ptilopsis:Inversion before sorting.
Ptilopsis:MergeSort.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Sort your draw pile by cost, drawing the cheapest cards first. NL Gain !B! Block for each ptilopsis:Inversion before sorting. NL Draw !M! card.

Ptilopsis:QuickIteration.NAME: Quick Iteration
Ptilopsis:QuickIteration.DESCRIPTION: Add !M! random Ptilopsis cards to your hand. NL They cost 0 this combat and gain Exhaust. NL Exhaust.

Ptilopsis:Offline.NAME: Offline
Ptilopsis:Offline.DESCRIPTION: Exhaust up to !M! cards from your hand and pack them into 1 Fixed ptilopsis:Thread. NL ptilopsis:Function: play temporary copies for free in selection order, targeting random enemies. NL ptilopsis:Destruct: gain !B! Block.
EXTENDED_DESCRIPTION: Choose cards in replay order (you may choose none)

Ptilopsis:Magallan.NAME: Magallan
Ptilopsis:Magallan.DESCRIPTION: Retain. NL Costs 1 less for each other card played this combat. NL After this turn ends, take an extra turn. NL Exhaust.

Ptilopsis:Rosmontis.NAME: Rosmontis
Ptilopsis:Rosmontis.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage to ALL enemies. NL For each ptilopsis:Thread, deal 1 ptilopsis:Aftershock to ALL enemies for half the initial damage.

Ptilopsis:ExtremeDataConstruction.NAME: Extreme Data Construction
Ptilopsis:ExtremeDataConstruction.DESCRIPTION: ptilopsis:Master_Theorem you apply no longer halves after causing HP loss.
Ptilopsis:ExtremeDataConstruction.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: ptilopsis:Master_Theorem you apply no longer halves after causing HP loss. NL Draw !M! card.

Ptilopsis:Muelsyse.NAME: Muelsyse
Ptilopsis:Muelsyse.DESCRIPTION: She will help you at the right moment! NL Heal !M! HP. NL Exhaust.

Ptilopsis:Closure.NAME: Closure
Ptilopsis:Closure.DESCRIPTION: Innate. NL Lose !M! Gold, or all your Gold if you have less. NL Upgrade all your cards for this combat. NL After winning, upgrade 1 random card in your deck. NL Exhaust.
